reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Two of these side by side is the whole point
reviews.body: One cable to the laptop, 90W back the other way, and the bezels are thin enough that two of them read as one desktop. Docked a star because the stand needs a hex key you do not get in the box.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Replaced two older panels with one
reviews.body: Colour out of the box was close enough that I never opened the calibrator. Menu joystick is better than any button row.

reviews.author: bob
reviews.title: Fine, but read the refresh rate again
reviews.body: It is 60Hz. If you came from a 144Hz gaming panel you will notice, and no firmware update is going to change it.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Ethernet finally keeps up
reviews.body: 2.5Gb to the switch and the dock does not warm up. The SD reader is slower than the spec sheet suggests.

reviews.author: bob
reviews.title: Third one I have bought
reviews.body: Hot-swap means it outlives whatever switch fashion is current. Back in stock and I buy another.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Chapter 7 is the one
reviews.body: The chapter on ordered inputs is worth the cover price on its own. We handed it round the team before the Atlas review.

search_entries.snippet: Placed for $429.99 and delivered. This is the order the card charge on northwind.example points back at.
